body.content: Designed and implemented a multi-threaded trading simulation engine with order lifecycle management, position reconciliation, and event-driven strategy replay. Core components include - broker service, position manager, strategy engine, simulation framework. Validated system reliability through Monte Carlo simulations of 10k+ concurrent orders.

Spearheaded development of a 3D visualization tool for implied volatility surfaces in Python and deployed using Streamlit that allows Black-Scholes calculations for configurable set of parameters to identify pricing inefficiencies. Projected the slices of the 3D surface onto the Bures-Wasserstein manifold and used optimal transport to gain deeper insights into volatility shifts. Developed a high-performance server to periodically capture and store the implied volatility surface of configurable option tickers. Implemented the server using Python (Asyncio) for asynchronous tasks and PostgreSQL for efficient time-series data storage. Deployed the system on Docker.
AI-powered tool to estimate remaining cooking time from food images in real-time.
Machine Learning System designed for language learning based on feedback and ways I teach myself languages.

Invitational competition where we worked on analyzing datasets in groups. The purpose of the project was to analyze how various energy-related variables, such as fossil fuel consumption and renewable energy production, impact socioeconomic indicators like unemployment and personal income across different U.S. states. My contributions focused on exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering, including the ideation process of model development such as Random Forest and Lasso Regression. We also trained an LSTM neural network to forecast crude oil prices, achieving a 0.89 R², and provided valuable insights into how oil prices might evolve in the near future. Our team won the 1st place.

Created a novel data imputation approach for drug-target interaction matrices by integrating matrix factorization with weighted random walk score propagation on a human protein-protein interactome. Developed and validated the model using k-fold CV, leveraging neural network property predictors and augmenting datasets with random-walk-imputed interactomes. Reduced RMSE by 18.8%, achieving consistent molecular optimization success rates; voted best project in class.

Designed Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs) to extract low-dimensional representations of mutation, gene expression, and molecular fingerprints, reducing reliance on large labeled datasets and hand-engineered features. Integrated the Junction Tree VAE for molecule representation learning. Built a supervised deep neural network model to predict drug sensitivity (IC50) by combining the encoded features. Leveraged public datasets including CCLE and GDSC for model training and evaluation, achieving improved performance (R² = 0.81) over traditional models.
